description: Defines HTTP/QUIC frame types and associated data structures for HTTP frames in QUIC protocol implementation.

classes.name: DataFrame
classes.description: Represents a data frame carrying payload data.

classes.name: HeadersFrame
classes.description: Represents a headers frame carrying header block.

classes.name: SettingsFrame
classes.description: Represents a settings frame with configuration parameters.

classes.name: GoAwayFrame
classes.description: Represents a GOAWAY frame to initiate connection shutdown.

classes.name: PriorityUpdateFrame
classes.description: Represents a priority update frame for stream prioritization.

classes.name: AcceptChFrame
classes.description: Represents an ACCEPT_CH frame with origin and value entries.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts frame data to string representation.

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Stream insertion operator for printing frame data.
